RESULTS.RELATIVE_ACCOUNTS: Relative accounts (Ğ1 relative to current UD)

COMPARE.BEHAVIOURS_UNUSED: No action was played during this game.
COMPARE.LEGEND_CARDS: cards, at their price in money
COMPARE.LEGEND_CARDS_JUNE: cards, price converted to Ğ1 at the final UD (1 UD = {{du}} Ğ1)
COMPARE.LEGEND_DEBT: debt still owed at the end (principal + interest)
COMPARE.SCORE_RULE_JUNE: Score = coins + cards across all their lives.
COMPARE.SCORE_RULE_GROSS: Score = coins + cards across all their lives. Repaid credits are already taken out (those coins went back to the bank), but the debt still owed is not deducted.
COMPARE.SCORE_RULE_NET: Score = coins + cards − debt still owed: what the player would keep after paying the bank back.
COMPARE.LEGEND_POVERTY: poverty line: 60% of the median score (INSEE and Eurostat convention)
COMPARE.LEGEND_LIVES: Both lives count: a player who died and came back adds up what their 1st life still held at death and what their 2nd life owns at the end.
COMPARE.MONETARY_MASS_INFO_DEBT: All coins in play. The start is measured when the game is launched: starting coins + credits granted before launch (1st credit). After that, every credit creates money; every repayment, interest payment or coin seizure destroys some.
COMPARE.MONETARY_MASS_INFO_JUNE: All coins in play. The start is measured when the game is launched (starting coins). After that, every UD creates money and nothing destroys it: dead players' coins are still counted (ghost money).
COMPARE.INTEREST_EARNED_INFO: Total interest paid to the bank: when a credit is repaid, at each extension and during seizures. This money leaves the monetary mass.
COMPARE.SEIZURES_INFO: Number of seizures made by the bank: one per defaulted credit, plus one each time a player dies still in debt.
COMPARE.MONEY_LOST_INFO: Debt the bank could not recover through seizures: principal + interest (+ seizure fees), minus the coins seized and the value of the cards seized (after any discount).
COMPARE.MONEY_DESTROYED_INFO: Principal of the credits repaid to the bank (interest excluded): the money created by a credit disappears when it is repaid.
COMPARE.GOODS_SEIZED_INFO: Total value (card prices) of the goods taken by the bank during seizures. These cards go back into the deck.
COMPARE.GHOST_MONEY_INFO: Coins dead players were still holding at the end of the game: still counted in the monetary mass, but nobody can spend them anymore.
COMPARE.GHOST_CARDS_INFO: Value of the cards dead players were still holding at the end of the game: they no longer circulate.
